span.p:
React app (Vite, TypeScript)
pages/ + features/: employee, technician, admin screens
api/: fetch with JWT + TanStack Query cache
live/: EventSource for Server-Sent Events
auth/: token storage, role-based routes

checks the JWT, applies role rules per URL
